item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena is helping her grandmother in the kitchen. They have a bowl of wheat grains mixed with some small stones and a few pieces of husk. Her grandmother wants to remove the unwanted pieces before grinding the wheat.

In which situation is handpicking the most suitable method of separation?

options.A: When the mixture contains a very large quantity of tiny sand particles spread evenly through the wheat.
options.B: When the unwanted pieces are few in number and large enough to be seen clearly and picked out by hand.
options.C: When the unwanted material is dissolved in water along with the useful material.
options.D: When one solid in the mixture is attracted by a magnet and the other is not.
